en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden railway station building with steep tiled roofs, decorative gables and two chimneys. Several people stand on the platform in front. A semaphore signal stands to the left and telegraph/flag poles to the right. The station name sign on the building reads "TRÄFVAD". Printed caption text appears at the bottom in a serif font.
